methods: Check a fixed-inventory ceiling and source equivalence before any explicitly bounded residual search.
Price a genuinely changed word/interface under a newly applicable model.

State the applicable fixed-inventory ceiling and remaining headroom; changed words or interfaces require a new fully charged model. Do not launch a residual search without an explicit scope and time cap.

original_card.first_experiment: Default to a bounded headroom/source-equivalence check. A changed word or interface needs a fresh cost model, not the old ceiling. Stop at the fixed-inventory cap; do not extend by new random seeds.
